title: nerium indicum var. odorum
intro: Nerium indicum var. odorum, commonly known as the Indian oleander, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include cardenolides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-proliferative, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of the Indian oleander may also contribute to its potential use in treating various conditions, including cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and certain types of cancer.
